meta.title: Priestess · Companion
meta.description: Priestess floats above the DSH page where no chat box or sidebar can cover her. Your DeepSeek account balance sits beside her; clicking her plays a random voice line and floats the line "Don't forget me, Doctor." Drag her anywhere and she stays where you put her. A grey outline and cast shadow follow her silhouette, and her size, corner and refresh cadence are all configurable.
